"""
import json
import time
import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from solver import solve_mckp_constrained, solve_mckp, uniform_quantization_baseline
from eval_ppl import patch_attention, restore_attention, evaluate_perplexity


MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2___5-7B"
DEVICE = "cuda:0"
BUDGET = 0.25
MAX_2BIT = 8
OUTPUT = "exp_c_results.json"


def main():
    print("Loading PPL profiles from full_bitwidth_results.json...")
    with open("full_bitwidth_results.json") as f:
        profiles = json.load(f)["profiles"]

    # Constrained solver (D009)
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Constrained MCKP (max_2bit={MAX_2BIT}, L0 excluded from 2-bit)")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    t0 = time.time()
    constrained = solve_mckp_constrained(
        profiles, BUDGET, mode="quant_only",
        max_2bit=MAX_2BIT, l0_exclude_2bit=True
    )
    t_solve = time.time() - t0
    print(f"Bit distribution: {constrained['bit_distribution']}")
    print(f"Memory ratio: {constrained['actual_memory_ratio']:.4f} (target: {BUDGET})")
    print(f"Total distortion: {constrained['total_distortion']:.4f}")
    print(f"2-bit count: {constrained['n_2bit']}")
    print(f"Solve time: {t_solve:.2f}s")

    # Unconstrained for comparison
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("Unconstrained MCKP (original)")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    unconstrained = solve_mckp(profiles, BUDGET, mode="quant_only")
    unc_bits = {}
    for key, (atype, param) in unconstrained["allocation"].items():
        b = 16 if atype == "full" else param
        unc_bits[b] = unc_bits.get(b, 0) + 1
    print(f"Bit distribution: {unc_bits}")
    print(f"Memory ratio: {unconstrained['actual_memory_ratio']:.4f}")

    uniform = uniform_quantization_baseline(profiles, bits=4)

    # L0 allocations
    print(f"\nLayer 0 allocations:")
    for h in range(4):
        key = f"0,{h}"
        c = constrained["allocation"].get(key, ["?", "?"])
        u = unconstrained["allocation"].get(key, ["?", "?"])
        print(f"  L0H{h}: constrained={c[1]}bit, unconstrained={u[1]}bit")

    # Model load + PPL eval
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("Loading model for WikiText-2 PPL evaluation...")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        MODEL, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="eager"
    )
    model = model.to(DEVICE)
    model.eval()

    # Baseline
    print("\nEval: baseline (no quant)...")
    baseline_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, DEVICE)
    print(f">>> Baseline PPL: {baseline_ppl:.4f}")

    # Constrained MCKP
    print("\nEval: constrained MCKP...")
    orig = patch_attention(model, constrained["allocation"])
    constrained_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, DEVICE)
    restore_attention(model, orig)
    print(f">>> Constrained MCKP PPL: {constrained_ppl:.4f}")

    # Unconstrained MCKP
    print("\nEval: unconstrained MCKP...")
    orig = patch_attention(model, unconstrained["allocation"])
    unconstrained_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, DEVICE)
    restore_attention(model, orig)
    print(f">>> Unconstrained MCKP PPL: {unconstrained_ppl:.4f}")

    # Uniform 4-bit
    print("\nEval: uniform 4-bit...")
    orig = patch_attention(model, uniform["allocation"])
    uniform_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, tokenizer, DEVICE)
    restore_attention(model, orig)
    print(f">>> Uniform 4-bit PPL: {uniform_ppl:.4f}")

    # Verdict
    delta_vs_uniform = uniform_ppl - constrained_ppl
    passed = constrained_ppl <= 14.95 and constrained["actual_memory_ratio"] <= 0.25
    verdict = "PASS" if passed else "FAIL"

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print("RESULTS")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"{'Method':<30} {'PPL':>10} {'Memory':>10}")
    print("-" * 52)
    print(f"{'Baseline':<30} {baseline_ppl:>10.2f} {'1.0000':>10}")
    print(f"{'Uniform 4-bit':<30} {uniform_ppl:>10.2f} {'0.2500':>10}")
    print(f"{'Unconstrained MCKP':<30} {unconstrained_ppl:>10.2f} {unconstrained['actual_memory_ratio']:>10.4f}")
    print(f"{'Constrained MCKP (D009)':<30} {constrained_ppl:>10.2f} {constrained['actual_memory_ratio']:>10.4f}")
    print(f"\nConstrained vs uniform: {delta_vs_uniform:+.2f}")
    print(f"Pass: PPL <= 14.95 AND memory <= 0.25")
    print(f"Verdict: {verdict}")

    results = {
        "verdict": verdict,
        "baseline_ppl": baseline_ppl,
        "constrained_ppl": constrained_ppl,
        "unconstrained_ppl": unconstrained_ppl,
        "uniform_4bit_ppl": uniform_ppl,
        "delta_vs_uniform": delta_vs_uniform,
        "constrained_memory_ratio": constrained["actual_memory_ratio"],
        "constrained_bit_distribution": constrained["bit_distribution"],
        "constrained_n_2bit": constrained["n_2bit"],
        "unconstrained_memory_ratio": unconstrained["actual_memory_ratio"],
        "unconstrained_bit_distribution": unc_bits,
        "constrained_allocation": constrained["allocation"],
        "config": {
            "model": MODEL,
            "budget": BUDGET,
            "max_2bit": MAX_2BIT,
            "l0_exclude_2bit": True,
        }
    }
    with open(OUTPUT, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved to {OUTPUT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    """Monkey-patch attention layers to apply per-head compression.

    n_groups = num_q_heads // num_kv_heads

        attn = layer.self_attn

                atype, param = allocations[key]
                head_allocs[h] = (atype, param)
            else:
                head_allocs[h] = ("full", 16)

            continue

        original_forwards[layer_idx] = attn.forward

        def make_forward(orig_attn, h_allocs, has_evict, n_kv=num_kv_heads, ng=n_groups, hd=head_dim):

                v = orig_attn.v_proj(hidden_states).view(bsz, seq_len, n_kv, hd).transpose(1, 2)

                cos, sin = position_embeddings
                q, k = apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin)

                # Per-head quantization
                for h in range(n_kv):
                    atype, param = h_allocs[h]
                    if atype == "quant" and int(param) < 16:
                        bits = int(param)
                        k[:, h] = quantize_per_channel(k[:, h:h + 1], bits).squeeze(1)
                        v[:, h] = quantize_per_token(v[:, h:h + 1], bits).squeeze(1)

                k_exp = repeat_kv(k, ng)
                v_exp = repeat_kv(v, ng)

        shift_labels = chunk[:, 1:].contiguous()

            shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.shape[-1]),
            shift_labels.view(-1),
            reduction="sum",
        )

        total_tokens += shift_labels.numel()
